name: Bert Craterfill
acting: Low gaze and long downturned lip.
personality: Repairs potholes in places nobody was meant to walk.
note: The tile broke on its own. He wanted this noted before they authorized its next orbit.

name: Iris Gasketear
acting: One eye shut and a tight mouth.
personality: Can identify a leak by the opinion it whistles.
note: The gasket was making a tiny statement about the pressure schedule. Iris asked for a second reading.
voice: Dry, with a slight upward inflection.

name: Cal Upbend
acting: One raised lid and a crooked smirk.
personality: Finds the wrong direction reassuringly familiar.
note: The drop was leaving through a perfectly good inlet. Cal marked it as an ambition problem.

name: Vera Wipewing
acting: Gaze up and teeth tightly clenched.
personality: Polishes a solar tile as if it will remember the effort.
note: She wiped off a comet streak and found a second one in exactly the same place. The sun had been taking notes.

name: Len Moonmeter
acting: Sideways gaze and a puckered O.
personality: Bills the moon by how full it looks.
note: The meter showed a crescent. Len asked whether we intended to pay for the missing part.

name: Dex Sparksnip
acting: Eyes down and a one-tooth grin.
personality: Celebrates the moment just before a fuse objects.
note: Dex joined two cables that had been avoiding each other for years. Their first conversation was quite brief.
